# Known R4 hardware passes: SD red on removal, no stutter, full-width SD browser.
# R7: dedicated SD SPI reinitialization, immediate RESCAN worker wake,
# visible remount status/attempt count, and direct physical-drive format.
# Format obtains exact FF drive from sdcard_init(SD_CS_PIN,&SPI,4MHz),
# f_mkfs on that drive; works on FAT-unmountable card, no guessed volume.
# Format only after TWO irreversible confirmations; no fallback erase.
# Must test on expendable/backed-up card. CYD 2.8 ST7789, CYD 3.2 ST7798.
